items.title: COP31 Antalya: likely overrun into Saturday; final cover decision ('Antalya Declaration') still unagreed
items.title_cs: Klimatická konference COP31 v Antalyi se nejspíš protáhne do soboty, o závěrečném textu („Antalyjská deklarace“) se stále jedná
items.institution: UNFCCC / COP31 presidency (Kurum; Bowen president of negotiations)
items.note: Thu 19 Nov afternoon: new 9-page draft (vs 18 pages on Monday) drops ALL fossil-fuel references (both 'transition away' and 'phase out' options), drops mention of Brazil's fossil-fuel roadmap and the $120bn-by-2035 adaptation-finance target (keeps COP30 'triple adaptation finance' with further work on baseline); keeps the 35% electricity share of final energy by 2035 goal (softened). Bowen: 'best basis' for agreement; first COP to acknowledge 1.5C will not be met; EU studying the text overnight, ministers reconvene Friday. Reuters via CBC: revised text 'not expected to be the final version'. Panama threatened to block any deal without oil-production/methane limits; G77+China vs EU split on the Just Transition Mechanism (commonspace.eu). Recent COPs (COP29, COP30) ended on Saturday. Other sources: https://www.cbc.ca/news/science/cop31-draft-climate-deal-9.7427790 ; https://www.commonspace.eu/news/cop31-update-11-draft-deal-drops-fossil-fuel-references Corrected 20 Nov: the second draft (19 Nov) drops all mention of fossil fuels; the immediate-transition wording was only in the first draft (Carbon Brief).
